_comment: Human-editable and authoritative: the model never overrules this file.
European Spanish (es-ES): 'coste' over 'costo'. Change here, not in prompts.
locked — tokens that must survive verbatim into Spanish (content/SCHEMA.md 'Do not translate').
The §3.1 dial parameter names (duty, fidelity, latency, noise, control, contrary) and the
receipt symbol 'u' are NOT locked here although SCHEMA.md lists them: they are composed in
JS and never appear in map prose, and 'u' is a Spanish conjunction. If they ever enter the
map as literals, add them back.
preferred — the terms of art, fixed once so the site never calls one thing by three names.
en:    the English term, matched as a whole word (plural allowed, hyphenated
compounds and other suffixes not: 'seat' does not fire on 're-seats')
use:   the Spanish term the translation must use
match: the stem the compliance check looks for in the Spanish (defaults to 'use');
keep stems short and unaccented-safe so gender and number both match
caseSensitive: require the capital. Rarely needed in Spanish, which does not
capitalize common nouns the way German does.
The second block mirrors the terms the German pilot caught the model guessing wrong
on short UI strings (witness/report, fidelity/loyalty, collapse/grip, preset). They
are pinned here up front so Spanish does not have to rediscover the same failures.
